business_problem: Enova improved its security posture, achieving 99.7% uptime. It increased operational efficiency, boosted revenue, and realized substantial cost savings by avoiding multiple data centers and extra staff.
solution_summary: Enova built this solution on Azure Logic Apps, Power BI. Enova improved its security posture, achieving 99.7% uptime. It increased operational efficiency, boosted revenue, and realized substantial cost savings by avoiding multiple data centers and extra staff. Azure Logic Apps automates cross-system workflows and security or business process integrations. Power BI publishes dashboards and self-service analytics to business users. To maintain peak uptime and secure data, Enova connected over 250,000 IoT and operational endpoints to Microsoft Azure, centralizing Azure Data Lake and Azure Data Warehouse. Power BI, embedded into Enova’s customer portal, now provides user-friendly dashboards and valuable insights. Operational data is collected from line-of-business systems, processed inside the analytics platform before Power BI dashboards surface insights to business users.
